description: Real Webflow-staging -> localhost rebuild migration of the Hiya Connect number-registration page. Locks a true-positive broken-link regression: the 'See Branded Call Plans' CTA in <main> targets /products/connect/pricing, which 200s on staging but 404s on the rebuild, and matchy catches it. Surrounded by extensive incidental migration drift (see knownDrift). Proves the Tier-3 capture -> freeze -> explain -> assert loop end-to-end on a real page.
discoveredVia: Real migration QA: Webflow staging vs in-progress localhost rebuild (make pair-add)
knownDrift: Global nav/footer menu not yet ported to the localhost rebuild: most of the 35 missing_link + 14 missing_text issues are nav/footer entries under the RESOURCES / SOLUTIONS / PRODUCTS / CONSIDERING-HIYA landmarks (Developer Docs, Carriers, Contact us, Trust Center, Events, Blog, Press Kit, Terms of Service, etc.).
Weglot translation widget absent on the rebuild: the 'ENGLISH' language switcher (missing_button) and its per-language slug requests do not exist on localhost.
Homepage links gained an /en-US locale prefix on the rebuild: '/' -> '/en-US' (changed_link_target, uncertain band).
Top-nav dropdown button labels are empty on the rebuild (changed_link_text: Resources / Products / Solutions / Why Hiya?).
Broad CSS differences between Webflow staging and the rebuild account for the ~185 style_changed issues.
Decorative icon SVG (fi_x.svg, served from website-files.com) is absent on the rebuild (missing_image).
